```{r envision_paths, include=FALSE}
.envision_input <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")
.envision_candidates <- unique(c(
  Sys.getenv("ENVISION_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = ""),
  if (length(.envision_input) && nzchar(.envision_input)) dirname(.envision_input) else character(),
  getwd()
))
.envision_candidates <- .envision_candidates[nzchar(.envision_candidates) & dir.exists(.envision_candidates)]
.envision_config <- ""
.envision_cursor <- ""
for (.envision_start in .envision_candidates) {
  .envision_probe <- normalizePath(.envision_start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    .envision_candidate <- file.path(.envision_probe, "R", "envision_paths.R")
    if (file.exists(.envision_candidate)) {
      .envision_cursor <- .envision_probe
      .envision_config <- .envision_candidate
      break
    }
    .envision_parent <- dirname(.envision_probe)
    if (identical(.envision_parent, .envision_probe)) break
    .envision_probe <- .envision_parent
  }
  if (nzchar(.envision_config)) break
}
if (!nzchar(.envision_config)) stop("No se encontró R/envision_paths.R")
options(envision.project_root = .envision_cursor)
source(.envision_config)
```

```{r Import CTD files, include=FALSE}

Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION  <- Metadata_ENVISION %>%
  dplyr::select(-DOC, -TN,	-DON, -PP_0.2, -PP_0.2_SD, -PP_3, -PP_3_SD, -PP_total, -PP_total_ee, -BP, -BP_ee, -X, -lat, -lon) %>%
        mutate(NP = (NO2 + NO3 + NH4) / PO4) %>%
  filter(Depth=="5")



ENVISION_CDT_metadata <- ENVISION_CDT %>%
  unite(day, D, day, sep="", remove=T) %>%
  unite(sample, cruise, day, station, sep="_", remove=F) %>%
  filter( day %in% c("D1", "D3", "D5", "D7")) %>%
  filter(Depth=="5") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Depth, -pres, -X, -cruise, -day, -station)


all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION <- Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION %>%
  left_join(ENVISION_CDT_metadata, by ="sample") %>%
inner_join(Seasons_tags, by="sample")
# write.csv(all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION, calculation_file("all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION.csv"))

all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION_long <- pivot_longer(all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION,
                                            cols=6:27, names_to = "Metadata", values_to = "Value") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Depth)

all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION_long <- all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION_long %>%
      separate(Season_Station, c("Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=F)

```




```{r PLOTTING lineplot of selected environmental variables, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
Superficial_Top_environmentals <- all_Superficial_Metadata_ENVISION_long %>%
      separate(Season_Station, c("Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=F) %>%
      filter(Metadata %in% c(
                             "Salinity",
                             "Temperature",
                             "Chlorophyll_a"))



  Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata  <- factor(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata,
                                                        levels = c(
                                                          "Salinity",
                                                          "Temperature",
                                                          "Chlorophyll_a"))

  Superficial_Top_environmentals$Season  <- factor(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer"))

  Superficial_Top_environmentals$Station  <- factor(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Station, levels = c("Offshore","Coast"))

  # levels(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata) <- gsub("_", "\n", levels(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata))

Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata <- factor(Superficial_Top_environmentals$Metadata,
                                                  levels = c("Salinity",
                                                          "Temperature",
                                                          "Chlorophyll_a"),
                  labels = c("Salinity\n(PSU)",
                             "Temperature\n(ºC)",
                             "Chlorophyll a\n(mg m⁻³)")
                  )
# ⁺⁻³¹
# ₁₂₃₂₄  ₁   ₂µ

Superficial_Top_environmentals_boxplot1 <- ggplot(Superficial_Top_environmentals, aes(x=Season, y=Value, fill=Season)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.8)+
  ggtitle ("")+
  labs(x = "",y = "")+
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))+
  theme(plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=12, face = "bold")) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=12)) + # Values
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))+
  theme( legend.position = 'none')+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("royalblue4", "orangered4", "seagreen4" )) +
facet_grid(Metadata ~ Station, scales = "free_y") +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,0.1,0,0.1, "cm")))+
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
      "Winter" = "WIN",
      "Spring" = "SPG",
      "Summer" = "SUM" )) +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"))
Superficial_Top_environmentals_boxplot1
```

```{r Import Definitive-ENVISION dataset March 2022 (envision_general_metabolism.feather), cache = TRUE}
# Import Definitive-ENVISION dataset June 2022
# data set (26/05/2022)

env <- calculation_file("envision_general_metabolism_june2022.feather")
env_general_feater <- read_feather(env) %>%
  filter(!is.na(superkingdom),superkingdom != 'Eukaryota', superkingdom != 'Viruses',superkingdom != 'Archaea') %>%
    mutate(superkingdom = ifelse(is.na(superkingdom) | superkingdom == '', 'No
domain', superkingdom),phylum = ifelse(is.na(phylum) | phylum == '', sprintf('%s, no phylum',
                                                          superkingdom), phylum))

```


```{r Deleting the re-seq days and adding  profiles to ENVISION-mRNASeq data, include=FALSE, cache = TRUE}

env_field_feater <- env_general_feater %>%
  filter(sample %in% sample_names_ENV_field$sample) %>% # 1,104,943 entries, 25 total columns
    filter(sample !="ENV1_D5_S3") %>%
    filter(sample !="ENV3_D5_S3") %>%
    separate(sample, c("cruise", "day", "station", "reseq"), sep="_", remove=F) %>%
    unite(sample2, cruise, day, station, sep="_", remove=F) %>%
    unite(profile_protein, profile, protein, sep="_", remove=F) %>%
    dplyr::select (-sample, -reseq) %>%
    dplyr::rename (sample=sample2) %>% # 1,040,735 entries, 29 total columns
    full_join(profile_protein_list_allgenes, by="profile") # 1,040,758 entries, 38 total columns
# write.csv(env_field_feater,"env_field_feater.csv")



```

```{r Correcting the taxa, include=FALSE, cache = TRUE}
# let's get rid of "uncl." tags
ENV_field_2022 <- env_field_feater %>%   # We keep the same  1,040,758 entries and 38 total columns
    separate(phylum, c("phylum", "X1"), sep=" uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    separate(class, c("class", "X2"), sep=" uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    separate(order, c("order", "X3"), sep=" uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    separate(family, c("family", "X4"), sep=" uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    separate(genus, c("genus", "X5"), sep="uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    separate(species, c("species", "X6"), sep=" uncl.", remove=F) %>%
    dplyr::select (-X1, -X2, -X3, -X4, -X5, -X6)
# write.csv(ENV_field_2020, "ENV_field_2020.csv")
```

```{r}
Para_Sandra_Environmental_and_genes_ratios <- read.csv(
  calculation_file("Para_Sandra_Environmental_and_genes_ratios.csv"), sep = ";") %>%
  column_to_rownames('sample')   %>%
  dplyr::select(-1)
```

```{r, fig.height=18, fig.width=18}

##correlaciones de Spearman
spearman_bac<- cor(Para_Sandra_Environmental_and_genes_ratios, use="complete.obs", method="spearman") #use= "complete.obs", eliminar los valores nan  por caso y poder tener una correlacion de esas variables

a <- rcorr(as.matrix(spearman_bac), type = "spearman")

# Quitamos las columnas y filas que no nos interesan para el gráfico
spearman<-spearman_bac[-c(1:12),-c(13:26)]
pvalue_spearman_todos <- a[["P"]]
pvalue_spearman <- pvalue_spearman_todos[-c(1:12),-c(13:26)]

corrected_pvalues <- p.adjust(as.vector(pvalue_spearman), method = "BH")
corrected_pvalues_reshape <- matrix(corrected_pvalues, nrow(spearman), ncol(spearman))

# Asignar nombres a las filas y columnas
dimnames(corrected_pvalues_reshape) <- list(rownames(spearman), colnames(spearman))

# view(corrected_pvalues_reshape)



Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot <- Heatmap(
  spearman,
  name = "Spearman Correlation",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  width = unit(27, "cm"),
  height = unit(15, "cm"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=18),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=18),
cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {# do not touch it!
          if(corrected_pvalues_reshape[i, j] <= 0.05) # Add a "character/symbol" in the box with a p-value equal to or less than 0.05
            grid.text(sprintf("•", corrected_pvalues_reshape[i, j]), x, y, gp=gpar(fontsize=30)) # Select the character/symbol
                                                              },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title="",
    labels_gp=gpar(fontsize=20),
    grid_height=unit(40,"mm"),
    legend_direction = "vertical",
    border=TRUE,
    legend_width = unit(8, "cm"),
    title_gp=gpar(fontsize=18, fontface="bold")
  ),
  row_title = "",
  column_title = "",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold")
)

Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot <- draw(
  Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot,
  merge_legend = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right"
)

png(figure_file("all_subcategories_vs_Euk_plot.png"),
    width = unit(1200, 'in'), # anchura en pulgadas
    height = unit(1200, 'in') # altura en pulgadas
)
Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot
```

```{r, fig.height=17, fig.width=15}
Important_subcategories <- ENV_field_2022_No_psbA %>%

                             "Photosynthesis"))%>%
mutate(subcategory = str_replace(subcategory, "Ferricuptake", "Ferric uptake"))%>%
mutate(subcategory = str_replace(subcategory, "B1", "Vitamins"))%>%
mutate(subcategory = str_replace(subcategory, "B12", "Vitamins")) %>%
mutate(subcategory = str_replace(subcategory, "Bacteriorhodopsin", "Proteorhodopsin")) %>%
    mutate(subcategory = str_remove(subcategory, '2'))

Important_subcategories$subcategory  <- factor(Important_subcategories$subcategory,
                  levels = c("Carbohydrate metabolism",
                             "TCA cycle",
                             "Amino acid metabolism",
                             "Ammonium uptake",
                             "Regulation of N utilization",
                             'Phosphate metabolism',
                             "DMSP assimilation",
                             "Sulfate assimilation",
                             "Sulfite assimilation",

                             "Siderophore metabolism",
                             "Chaperonins",
                             "Oxidative stress",
                             "Motility",
                             "Vitamins",
                             "Proteorhodopsin",
                             "Photosynthesis"
                             )) # "Replication and repair"

#   Para correlaciones entre subcategorias y abundancia relativa de Eukariotas
Correlations_subcategories <- Important_subcategories%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, tpm, subcategory) %>% # Our_Taxonomy
  group_by(sample, subcategory) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(tpm=sum(tpm)) %>%
  spread(subcategory, tpm, fill = 0.5) %>%
  filter(sample !="NA")

Correlations_subcategories_and_Eukariotyc_top_taxas <- Correlations_subcategories %>%
  left_join(Euk_ASVs, by="sample") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames('sample')

Correlations_subcategories_and_Eukariotyc_top_taxas_log <- log2(Correlations_subcategories_and_Eukariotyc_top_taxas)






##correlaciones de Spearman
spearman_bac<- cor(Correlations_subcategories_and_Eukariotyc_top_taxas_log, use="complete.obs", method="spearman") #use= "complete.obs", eliminar los valores nan  por caso y poder tener una correlacion de esas variables

a<- rcorr(as.matrix(spearman_bac), type="spearman") # para ver coeficientes de correlacion, p-value

#Quitamos las columnas y filas que no, nos interesan para el grÃ¡fico
spearman<-spearman_bac[-c(1:17),-c(18:34)]
pvalue_spearman_todos<-a[["P"]]
pvalue_spearman <-pvalue_spearman_todos[-c(1:17),-c(18:34)]

corrected_pvalues <- p.adjust(as.vector(pvalue_spearman), method = "BH")
corrected_pvalues_reshape <- matrix(corrected_pvalues, nrow(spearman), ncol(spearman))

# Asignar nombres a las filas y columnas
dimnames(corrected_pvalues_reshape) <- list(rownames(spearman), colnames(spearman))

# view(corrected_pvalues_reshape)


Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot <- Heatmap(
  spearman,
  name = "Spearman Correlation",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  width = unit(27, "cm"),
  height = unit(15, "cm"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=18),
  column_names_rot = 45,

cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {# do not touch it!
          if(corrected_pvalues_reshape[i, j] <= 0.01) # Add a "character/symbol" in the box with a p-value equal to or less than 0.05
            grid.text(sprintf("•", corrected_pvalues_reshape[i, j]), x, y, gp=gpar(fontsize=30)) # Select the character/symbol

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title="",

  ),
  row_title = "",
  column_title = "",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold")
)

  Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot,
  merge_legend = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right"
)

png(figure_file("Fig.6A.png"),
    width = unit(1200, 'in'), # anchura en pulgadas
    height = unit(1200, 'in') # altura en pulgadas
)
Correlations_subcategories_vs_environmental_plot
```

```{r, fig.height=18, fig.width=18}
                                                            name="Spearman Correlation",#datos que queremos graficar
                                                            cluster_rows=T, #  dendograma
                                                            cluster_columns =T, #  dendograma
                                                            clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean", #dendograma segÃºn distancia euclideana
                                                            width=unit(27,"cm"),#tamaÃ±o anchura del grÃ¡fico
                                                            height=unit(15,"cm"),#tamaÃ±o anchura del grÃ¡fico
                                                            row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize= 18),#tamaÃ±o de la letra de las filas
                                                            column_names_rot = 45,
                                                            row_names_rot = 0,
                                                            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=18),#tamaÃ±o de la letra de las columnas
                                                            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {# do not touch it!
          if(corrected_pvalues[i, j] <=0.05) # Add a "character/symbol" in the box with a p-value equal to or less than 0.05
            grid.text(sprintf("•", corrected_pvalues[i, j]), x, y, gp=gpar(fontsize=30)) # Select the character/symbol
                                                              }, # Comando loco para los asteriscos
          heatmap_legend_param = list(title="",
                                      labels_gp=gpar(fontsize=20),
                                      grid_height=unit(40,"mm"),
          legend_direction = "horizontal",
          border=TRUE,
                         legend_width = unit(8, "cm"),
          title_gp=gpar(fontsize=18, fontface="bold")),
          row_title = "", column_title = "18S vs 16S",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold"))#cambiamos altura de los colores de los labels Eukaryotas vs Prokaryotas


ASVs18S_vs_ASVs16S_log_plot <- draw(ASVs18S_vs_ASVs16S_log_plot, merge_legend = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side = "top",
    annotation_legend_side = "top")
```

```{r, cache = TRUE}
Gene_abundance <- env_field_feater %>%
  group_by(cruise, station, day, gene_protein, category, subcategory, importance, Filter) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm=sum(tpm)) %>%
  unite(cruise_station, cruise, station, sep="_") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(cruise_station !="NA_NA") %>%
  filter(category !="Otros") %>%
  # outer_join(Seasons_tags, by="cruise_station") %>%
  separate(cruise_station, c("cruise", "station"), sep="_", remove=F) %>%
  separate(day, c("D", "time"), sep="D", remove=T) %>%
  dplyr::select(-D) %>%
join(Seasons_tags_nodays, by="cruise_station")%>%
      separate(Season_Station, c( "Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=T)



Gene_abundance$Station  <- factor(Gene_abundance$Station,
                                                      levels = c( "Offshore", "Coast"))

Gene_abundance$Season  <- factor(Gene_abundance$Season,
                                                      levels = c( "Winter", "Spring", "Summer"))

Gene_abundance$importance  <- factor(Gene_abundance$importance,
                                                      levels = c( "high", "medium", "low"))
```

```{r}
# Helper function for string wrapping.
# Default 3 character target width.
swr = function(string, nwrap=10) {
  paste(strwrap(string, width=nwrap), collapse="\n")
}
swr = Vectorize(swr)

# Create line breaks in subcategory
Gene_abundance$subcategory = swr(Gene_abundance$subcategory)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
library(ggh4x)
unreal_gene <- read.csv(calculation_file("unreal_CN_gene.csv"), sep = ";")

Carbon_Gene_abundance <- Gene_abundance %>%
  filter(category=="Carbon metabolism")

Carbon_Gene_abundance = rbind(Carbon_Gene_abundance,
                   unreal_gene)

Carbon_Gene_abundance$Season <- factor(Carbon_Gene_abundance$Season,
                                              levels = c("Winter",
                                                         "Spring",
                                                         "Summer"),
                  labels = c("WIN",
                             "SPG",
                             "SUM"))

Carbon_Gene_abundance_plot <- ggplot(Carbon_Gene_abundance, aes(x=gene_protein, y=time, size=tpm, fill = tpm)) + #, color=FDR
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.4, shape = 21) +
  ggtitle("Carbon metabolism") +
  labs(x="Gene", y="Time (Day)", size="sumTPM") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))+
    theme(plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=16, face = "bold")) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=16, face = "bold")) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 16)) +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=16, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size=16, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="white")) +
    theme(legend.position="right") +
scale_fill_viridis(option="turbo", direction = 1) +
scale_size(range = c(.1, 20),breaks = c(100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000)) +
facet_nested(subcategory ~ Station+Season, scales = "free_y",  space = "free", strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=14)))+
  coord_flip()
Carbon_Gene_abundance_plot

ggsave(figure_file("Carbon_Gene_abundance_plot.png"),
       width = 25, # anchura
       height = 40, # altura
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 600)



```

```{r}
Bac_ASVs_2 <- Bac_ASVs %>%
    dplyr::rename (Rhodobacterales__1=Amylibacter) %>% #
    dplyr::rename (Rhodobacterales__2=Ascidiaceihabitans) %>% #
    dplyr::rename (Rhodobacterales__3=Planktomarina) %>% #
    dplyr::rename (Other_Prokaryotes__1=Planctomycetes)

Bac_ASVs_long_2 <- pivot_longer(Bac_ASVs_2, cols=2:16, names_to = "order", values_to = "ASV") %>%
    separate(order, c("order", "X1"), sep="__", remove=T) %>%
    dplyr::select (-X1)


Ratio_ASV <- Bac_ASVs_long_2 %>%
  inner_join(Seasons_tags, by="sample") %>%
  filter(order!= "Thaumarchaeota") %>%
  filter(order!= "Euryarchaeota") %>%
  dplyr::rename (Our_Taxonomy=order) %>% # este comando chiquito es para cambiar el nombre del header (elnuevo=elviejo)
  group_by(Season_Station, Our_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ASV=mean(ASV)) %>%
  unite(Identificator, Season_Station, Our_Taxonomy, sep="-", remove=T)


###############################
Ratio_metaT <- Order_proportion_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Season_Station, Our_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm=mean(tpm))

Most_important_Ratio_metaT <- Ratio_metaT %>%
  filter(Our_Taxonomy %in% order_list_2021$order)

Others_Ratio_metaT <- Order_proportion_mean_cruise_station %>%
  filter(Our_Taxonomy %in% order_list_2021$all_others)

vec <- c("Other\nbacteria") # este es el comando para sustituir mis ordenes
Others_Ratio_metaT$Our_Taxonomy <- vec

Others_Ratio_metaT <- Others_Ratio_metaT %>%
dplyr::group_by(Season_Station, Our_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm=mean(tpm)) %>%
  ungroup()

# union_all
Ratio_metaT <- union_all(Most_important_Ratio_metaT, Others_Ratio_metaT) %>%
  unite(Identificator, Season_Station, Our_Taxonomy, sep="-", remove=T)

Ratio_metaT_ASV <- Ratio_metaT %>%
    join(Ratio_ASV, by="Identificator") %>%
    mutate(ASV = if_else(is.na(ASV), 1, ASV)) %>%
      separate(Identificator, c("Season_Station", "Our_Taxonomy"), sep="-", remove=T) #%>%
      # separate(Season_Station, c("Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=T)
```

```{r}
Genes_abundance_plot2 <- Gene_abundance %>%
  dplyr::select(cruise_station, gene_protein, time, tpm) %>%
  unite(Identificator, cruise_station, gene_protein, sep="-", remove=T)

mean_by_days <- Gene_abundance %>%
  # filter(Filter=="yes") %>%
  group_by(cruise_station, gene_protein, category, subcategory, importance, Filter) %>%
    dplyr::select(cruise_station, gene_protein, tpm) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_tpm=mean(tpm)) %>%
  unite(Identificator, cruise_station, gene_protein, sep="-", remove=T) %>%
    dplyr::select(Identificator, mean_tpm, category, subcategory, importance, Filter)

Genes_abundance_ratio_plot <- Genes_abundance_plot2 %>%
  full_join(mean_by_days, by ="Identificator") %>%
    group_by(Identificator) %>%
    mutate(ratio_tpm = `tpm` / mean_tpm) %>%
    arrange(ratio_tpm) %>%
      separate(Identificator, c("Season", "Station"), sep="_", remove=T) %>%
      separate(Station, c("Station", "gene_protein"), sep="-", remove=T)  %>%
  unite(cruise_station, Season, Station, sep="_", remove=F) %>%
  unite(sample, cruise_station, time, sep="_", remove=F) %>%
  left_join(Seasons_tags_nodays, by="cruise_station") %>%
      separate(Season_Station, c( "Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=T)


Genes_abundance_ratio_plot$Season  <- factor(Genes_abundance_ratio_plot$Season,

Genes_abundance_ratio_plot$Station  <- factor(Genes_abundance_ratio_plot$Station,

                              "glnA",
                              "glnB",
                              "amt1",
                              "amt2",
                              "fbpA",
                              "ftnA")) %>%
    spread(gene_protein, ratio_tpm)

 write.csv(Para_Sandra_genes_ratio, figure_file("Para_Sandra_genes_ratio.csv"))
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=22, face = "bold")) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 22)) +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=22, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size=22, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="white")) +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
```
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
scale_fill_viridis(option="turbo", direction = -1) +
scale_size(range = c(.1, 20),breaks = c(100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000)) +
```
```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
   scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 3, by =2 )) +
    facet_nested(subcategory+gene_protein ~ Station+Season, scales = "free_x",  space = "free", strip = strip_nested(size = "variable"))+
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=8)))+
# guides(color = guide_legend(order=1),
 coord_flip()
```
